# CSOAI Open Stack Evidence Adapters

This is a **source-only integration candidate**, published on 28 September 2026 for reproducible review. It connects a bounded OpenBMC Redfish observation adapter and an OpenShell policy declaration to Council of AI's GSPC evidence vocabulary. It does not represent an OpenBMC, OpenShell, LFX, Open Secure AI Alliance, or vendor deployment or endorsement.

Kaggle unpacks the submitted tarball under `open-stack-integration-candidate-20260928/`. The 32 publicly downloadable files there match the 32 archive members byte for byte: 31 manifested source files plus the package manifest. For the **exact tarball bytes**, use the [version-pinned Hugging Face release](https://huggingface.co/datasets/csoai/gspc-board/resolve/d31e6707ae7b7b901e75a34081a723060e7d86be/examples/open-stack-integration-candidate-20260928.tar.gz), SHA-256 `2352f0170ddc5345827983c139f7bebe136c04a31f63465b802f66bdf4c9ef56`. Read the [scope and reproduction guide](https://huggingface.co/datasets/csoai/gspc-board/blob/b288079620fcc651fe8070dcbb6a9237426ac345/examples/open-stack-integration-candidate-20260928.md) before running it.

The local package verifier checked all 31 files, and nine bounded OpenBMC collector unit tests passed. The OpenShell policy declaration was checked against the live Council MCP inventory (16 tools: 12 free reads allowed, four paid names denied by the policy). Enforcement inside a real OpenShell sandbox and access to a consenting real BMC remain untested.

## Public-source watcher addendum

`source-watch-20260928-v2.zip` contains a small runnable change watcher, eight source/reference profiles, three unit tests, and three dated readbacks. Kaggle may display the ZIP as unpacked `source-watch/` files. On the second readback, all eight public sources were reachable: seven unchanged from the first pass and one first observation after replacing a blocked Red Hat documentation URL with Red Hat's public operator source. This is source-change observation only. It does not connect to any vendor tenancy, ingest confidential SAFE incidents, admit a GSPC measurement, or prove partnership. First or changed bytes produce a `STATIC_OBSERVED` review item; unchanged bytes produce no review work. The addendum manifest lists exact file hashes. Version 2 also treats a changed source URL as a review event even when its bytes match; the prior URL and digest are retained. [The same exact archive is on Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/datasets/csoai/gspc-board/resolve/be749e02d28c422a96fa5eef37981246b1214b6b/examples/open-stack-source-watch-20260928-v2.zip).

Use the [live GSPC board](https://councilof.ai/api/gspc) for current measurements. This archive is not itself an admitted board measurement, a signature, a Bitcoin timestamp, a security certification, or evidence of customer use. The source is MIT licensed; see `LICENSE`. No external party's confidential telemetry or credentials are included.

To reproduce, change into Kaggle's `open-stack-integration-candidate-20260928/` folder or extract the pinned Hugging Face archive, then run:

```text
python3 packaging/lfx-gspc/verify-local.py
python3 -m unittest discover -s integrations/openbmc-gspc/tests -v
python3 integrations/openshell-gspc/verify-package.py
```

The third command needs access to the public Council MCP endpoint. Do not point the collector at a BMC without its operator's authorization.
